prompt: Design a single-element spherical lens with a 50mm focal length, f/5, visible light (587nm), on-axis and 3 degrees off-axis. N-BK7 glass. Spherical surfaces only, no aspheres. Total track under 70mm, and leave at least 20mm of back focal distance for a sensor.

Design a cemented achromatic doublet, 100mm focal length, f/8, fields 0 and 2 degrees, wavelengths 486, 587 and 656nm. Two spherical elements, crown then flint. It must be genuinely achromatic: the focal length at 486 and 656nm must agree to within 0.05mm. Total track under 130mm.

Design a Cooke triplet: 50mm focal length, f/4.5, fields 0, 10 and 20 degrees, wavelengths 486, 587 and 656nm. Three spherical elements. Total track under 70mm. Keep RMS wavefront error under half a wave across the field.

Design a single-element spherical lens, 30mm focal length, f/2.5, on-axis only, 587nm, N-BK7. Spherical surfaces only, no aspheres. The element must have at least 1.0mm edge thickness and no more than 12mm center thickness. Total track under 45mm.
Design a single-element N-BK7 lens with a 100mm focal length and a total track of 5mm, f/2, on-axis, 587nm.

Design a receiver lens for a 905nm pulsed LiDAR. 25mm focal length, f/1.4, fields 0 and 3 degrees, single wavelength 905nm. Two spherical elements, air-spaced or cemented is your call. Spherical surfaces only, no aspheres. Total track under 45mm, and leave at least 12mm of back focal distance for the detector package.

Design a lens for an uncooled thermal imaging camera. 25mm focal length, f/1.2, fields 0 and 5 degrees, wavelength 10 microns. The material is germanium, which Optiland calls GE. One or two spherical elements. Spherical surfaces only, no aspheres. Total track under 40mm, and leave at least 10mm of back focal distance for the sensor package.

Design a 1:1 relay lens. The object sits 100mm in front of the first surface and must be imaged at unit magnification, so magnification of -1.0. f/4, fields 0 and 2 degrees, wavelengths 486, 587 and 656nm. Two spherical elements. Spherical surfaces only, no aspheres. Important: the object is at a finite distance, not at infinity, so set the thickness of surface 0 to 100 rather than leaving it null. Total track under 220mm.
